item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
• Click anything on Today and land on that exact message, highlighted: photos, videos, quotes, even the first-message milestones.
  • Navigation is now surgical at any scale. In very large conversations a click could land you years from the moment you wanted; anchors now converge on their target instead of trusting one estimate.
  • Jumping to a moment in the conversation you already have open works too, including links from the Info panel.
  • Photos that Messages moved to iCloud now say so plainly, and clicking the placeholder opens the conversation in Messages, the one app that can bring the file back. View in Messages also joins the Conversation menu and every message's right-click.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
• Shared links are finally beautiful: real preview cards in every conversation, built entirely from your archive, never fetched. Search finds links by their titles, and has:link joins the operator family.
  • Every conversation has an Info button (Cmd+I): what it is, its actions, and every link ever shared in it.
  • Cmd+K goes to any conversation by name. A click on a search result now lands on the exact message, highlighted.
  • Clicks tell the truth everywhere: Today cards open their own conversation, and thin conversations get a Visiting home in the sidebar instead of bouncing to All Messages.
  • A new Conversation menu puts every chat action in the menu bar where you can find it. Combined-thread controls retired; stitching just works.
  • Send Feedback lives in the Help menu and opens the project's issue tracker.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
• Delivered answers back: a composer under every conversation, quick reply on Today cards and search hits, and Cmd+N to start a conversation with anyone in Contacts.
  • Quick Send: press Ctrl+Option+D in any app, type a name and a message, press Return, and you never left what you were doing. The shortcut is yours to change in Settings.
  • Sends are honest: a two second window to catch a message before it goes, and nothing is marked delivered until it truly is. Your archive remains read-only, always.
  • Messages now arrive live while the app is open, with unread badges to match.
  • On This Day is now a true daily edition: the best year leads, conversations replay around each photo, and Cmd+G opens any date you remember.
  • Photos rescue: Messages quietly removes old attachment files from your Mac; Delivered can now recover them from your Photos library.
  • One person, one row: a friend who texts from a phone number and an email is finally a single conversation everywhere.
  • Delivered Help (Cmd+/) is a real keyboard cheat sheet, not an empty help book. Plus ambient video in memories, a smarter Settings window, and dozens of refinements.

item.title: Version 1.2.4
item.description: • Faster everywhere: the Today pane assembles in milliseconds, stats never block the window, and memories start instantly, even on very large libraries.

item.title: Version 1.2.3
item.description: • Delivered has an icon worthy of your dock: the blue balloon with the heart tapback.

item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description: • Housekeeping release. No changes you will notice.
